faqs.question: Can I download Twitter GIFs as video files?
faqs.answer: Yes! On X (Twitter), GIFs are stored internally as looping MP4 video streams. GoSaveClip extracts the native MP4 stream so it plays everywhere.

faqs.question: Does GoSaveClip support both x.com and twitter.com links?
faqs.answer: Yes! Whether your link uses x.com, twitter.com, or shortened t.co redirect URLs, GoSaveClip parses them seamlessly.

faqs.question: Can I download videos from protected X accounts?
faqs.answer: No. GoSaveClip only accesses publicly visible posts to protect creator privacy.

faqs.question: What is the highest quality available for X videos?
faqs.answer: GoSaveClip extracts the highest quality variant made available by X's video processing servers, up to 1080p at up to 60fps depending on source upload.

x-video-downloader.articleTitle: How to Download Videos & GIFs from X (Twitter) in Full HD
x-video-downloader.articleContent: X is the epicenter of global breaking news, aerospace milestones, sports highlights, and viral memes. However, X does not provide an offline download feature. GoSaveClip extracts the highest bitrate video variant directly from Twitter's CDN servers, ensuring you can save, archive, and view important footage offline in full clarity.

about.missionText: GoSaveClip was founded with a straightforward goal: to provide an effortless, high-performance web utility that allows people to save their favorite digital media without intrusive popups, deceptive ads, or quality-degrading compression. In an era where digital content disappears rapidly, we believe in giving individuals the tools to archive personal memories, educational lectures, creative inspirations, and critical news footage safely and securely.

values.title: Uncompromised Quality

values.title: Universal Accessibility

privacy.metaDesc: Read GoSaveClip's Privacy Policy. Learn how we protect user confidentiality, retain zero logs, and process media over encrypted connections.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Last updated: October 2026

sections.title: 1. Commitment to Privacy
sections.content: At GoSaveClip (accessible from gosaveclip.online), the privacy of our visitors is of paramount importance. This Privacy Policy document outlines the types of information we do and do not collect.

sections.title: 2. Zero Media Storage
sections.content: GoSaveClip does not store, host, archive, or cache any videos, audio tracks, or photos processed through our servers. All downloads are streamed transiently in real time from public social media CDN servers directly to your device.

sections.title: 3. No Personal Data Collection
sections.content: We do not require user accounts, credit card information, names, or contact details to use our download services. We do not track or profile user identity across third-party websites.

sections.title: 4. Contact Form Inquiries
sections.content: When you contact us using our contact form, your submission (name, email address, subject, and message) is securely processed by Web3Forms, a third-party form service, and delivered to our email inbox. We only use your email to reply to your message, and we never share or sell this information.

sections.title: 5. Log Files and Rate Limiting
sections.content: Like many websites, our servers temporarily maintain transient in-memory IP addresses solely for rate limiting, DDoS defense, and ensuring service availability. These records are purged automatically on a rolling basis.

sections.title: 6. Security
sections.content: All communication with GoSaveClip is encrypted using industry-standard Transport Layer Security (TLS/HTTPS) to protect data integrity and user confidentiality.

dmca.title: DMCA & Copyright Policy
dmca.subtitle: Respecting Intellectual Property Rights

sections.title: 1. Statement of Compliance
sections.content: GoSaveClip respects the intellectual property rights of others and adheres to the provisions of the Digital Millennium Copyright Act (17 U.S.C. § 512) and international copyright conventions.

sections.title: 2. No Content Hosted on Our Servers
sections.content: GoSaveClip is a technical proxy and indexing tool. We do not host, store, republish, or broadcast any video, audio, or photographic files on our servers. All media resides on third-party servers (e.g., TikTok, Instagram, Meta, Pinterest, X).

sections.title: 3. Removing Infringing Content at the Source
sections.content: Because GoSaveClip does not store files, the most effective way to eliminate infringing material is to submit a takedown request to the host platform (TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest, or X) where the content is hosted. Once removed or set to private on the host platform, GoSaveClip can no longer access it.

sections.title: 4. Notice of Copyright Infringement
sections.content: If you believe your copyrighted work is accessible through GoSaveClip in a manner that infringes your rights, you may submit a written notice to dmca@gosaveclip.online including: identification of the copyrighted work, URL of the infringing post, statement of good faith belief, and contact information.
